decisions.reason: The paragraph-specific quotation-mark edit is already owned by the source Requirement and does not change the copyediting goal or either approved passage in this candidate's current state.
The source concerns quotation marks in a referenced paragraph, not the unintended newline-marker text in the book title.
The source does not identify the referenced paragraph as a Mama's Hot Take section and does not necessarily alter the existing italic or whole-section quotation-mark rules.
Removing quotation marks from an unspecified paragraph does not change the requirement to provide back matter and author lines.
The source is a manuscript punctuation edit and has no effect on image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
Removing quotation marks does not change the deferred paragraph-spacing or body-density requirement.
The paragraph punctuation edit does not affect illustration source, suitability review, tone, or colour-palette criteria.
The source does not refer to Chapter 18 or change the requirement that its first line be distinguished as a subtitle.
The manuscript paragraph edit does not affect the cover image count, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover alternative.
Removing quotation marks from a paragraph does not alter table-of-contents page numbers or their update timing.
